notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Bug fix update was released on September 18, 2024.

■Update Details
・Fixed a bug where if you change the language to any language other than Japanese and exit the game, the language settings would not be reflected even when you restart the game and the game would return to the Japanese settings.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Please update the game.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Bug fix update was released on September 12, 2024.

■Update Details
・Fixed a bug where in some conversations, the name of the speaker of the line would display a different name.
・Fixed a bug where you could "Search" unexpected locations in some scenes.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Please update the game.
